DiaBuddy original pixel art, authored for this app.
Each PNG: 8 columns x 10 rows; 64 x 64 pixels per frame; 8 fps.
Row order and attachment coordinates: sprites.json.
Runtime: pixel-engine.js renders the corresponding layered artwork, with equipment behind/front ordering and frame-dependent arm anchors.
Sheets contain the default clothing and devices; the runtime layers allow independently equipped inventory items.
